title: A locally authenticated user can achieve privilege escalation via an insecure configuration that leads… (CVE-2026-9063)
description: CVE-2026-9063 is a vulnerability that allows a locally authenticated user to escalate privileges due to an insecure configuration. Exploitation requires prior authentication with an admin-privileged service account. Successful exploitation leads to unauthorized code execution with high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
